next_step: Complete air-gapped architecture review with infra team; produce draft SOW and hardware spec
notes:
- Prospect is a federally regulated dam and water-management operator.
- Very strict network posture: SCADA network completely air-gapped from corporate.
- Quote from CTO: 'We will not allow any external egress from the control cluster; keys and model artifacts must live entirely onsite.'
- Primary ask: Private (on-prem) deployment with explicit air-gapped install, HSM-backed keys, and isolated upgrade path.
- Interested in offline model transfer workflow, local model catalog, and rollback/rollback testing.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to reserved capacity for predictability but expects sliding penalties for failed uptime during maintenance windows.
- Will require a two-week onsite runbook validation and a red-team-style penetration review.
- Team composition: Ops (OT) lead + 2 SREs + 1 security engineer assigned to project.
- POC scope: 1 inference rack (8x A40 equiv), 3 application nodes, prefix/KV caching disabled initially for safety; evaluate batching after safety signoff.
- Legal/Security wants full source-of-truth for model provenance and a signed agreement that no telemetry leaves the site.

summary_requirements: Air-gapped Private deployment. Full on-prem model lifecycle: upload, version pinning, canary within isolated VLAN, HSM for key management, no egress telemetry, offline updates via signed bundles. SLOs: median token latency <120ms for 1k concurrent operator sessions in local LAN; throughput target 250 qps for low-latency reranking tasks. Compliance: SOC2/ISO baseline preferred; attestation reports required for install.
deal_notes_short: Large-regulated POC -> reserved private deployment. Heavy security gating. Procurement timeline ~Q1.
